settings.question: What makes these the Premium Segment?
settings.answer: These are our most comfortable everyday chairs. All three have a light aluminium frame, dual 250 W motors, electromagnetic brakes and a 15 km range, with extras like a bigger 12Ah battery (ComfortRide), a 160° recline (Premium Comfort) or a wide 50 cm seat (TravelMate).

settings.question: How far can they go on a single charge?
settings.answer: All three are rated for up to 15 km per charge, at a top speed of 6 km/h. Actual range depends on the user's weight, the road surface and slopes.

settings.question: How much weight can they carry?
settings.answer: All three Premium models support users up to 120 kg.

settings.question: Which Premium model is the lightest?
settings.answer: The Pulse TravelMate is the lightest at 23 kg. The Pulse ComfortRide and Pulse Premium Comfort weigh 27 kg each. All weights are without the battery.

settings.question: Can I take them on a flight?
settings.answer: All three are IATA compliant. Each airline makes its own final decision on mobility devices, so please check with your airline before you fly.

settings.question: How much do these wheelchairs weigh?
settings.answer: The Pulse UltraLight and Pulse MiniLite weigh just 19 kg each, and the Pulse SlimFold weighs 25 kg. All weights are without the battery.

settings.question: Which one is best for small homes?
settings.answer: The Pulse MiniLite is only 78 cm long, the most compact chair in our range. The Pulse SlimFold folds to just 38 cm wide, so it stores easily in a narrow space.

settings.question: How far can they go on a single charge?
settings.answer: All three are rated for up to 15 km per charge, at a top speed of 6 km/h. The SlimFold uses twin lithium-ion batteries.

settings.question: How much weight can they carry?
settings.answer: All three support users up to 120 kg.

settings.question: How do they fold?
settings.answer: The Pulse Everyday has a quick one-click fold. The Pulse SmartFold folds itself at the press of a button on the remote, so there is no lifting or wrestling with the frame.

settings.question: How much do they weigh?
settings.answer: Both weigh 22 kg without the battery, on a light aluminium frame.

settings.question: What is the range and weight capacity?
settings.answer: Both are rated for up to 15 km per charge at a top speed of 6 km/h, and support users up to 120 kg.

settings.question: Can I take them on a flight?
settings.answer: Both are IATA compliant for air travel. Each airline makes its own final decision on mobility devices, so please check with your airline before you fly.

settings.question: How much weight can they carry?
settings.answer: All three Heavy Duty models have a sturdy steel frame and support users up to 140 kg.

settings.question: How far can they go on a single charge?
settings.answer: All three use a large 24V 20Ah battery and are rated for up to 15 km per charge, at a top speed of 6 km/h.

settings.question: Which model can recline?
settings.answer: The Pulse HomeCare Recliner reclines up to 160° at the touch of a remote and has a headrest, so it suits users who sit for long hours or need to rest during the day.

settings.question: Can it be pushed by hand?
settings.answer: Yes, the Pulse DualDrive has large 23" rear wheels, so the user or a carer can push it by hand, and its dual 250 W motors take over whenever you want powered driving.

settings.question: Are they heavy to lift?
settings.answer: They weigh 31–39 kg without the battery, so lifting into a car usually needs two people. All three have an X-fold design for storage.

settings.question: What warranty do Pulse wheelchairs come with?
settings.answer: Every Pulse wheelchair comes with a 1-year warranty against manufacturing defects in the frame, motor and electrical parts. See our Warranty Policy page for full details.

settings.question: How long does delivery take?
settings.answer: Delivery is free across India and usually takes 3–5 business days, depending on your PIN code.

settings.question: Are the frames made of carbon fibre?
settings.answer: No. Most Pulse chairs have a light aluminium frame, and the heavy-duty models and SlimFold use a sturdy steel frame. The carbon-fibre look on some models is a hydro-dipped colour finish.

settings.help_heading: Not sure which one is right for you?
settings.help_text: Talk to a Pulse mobility expert. Free advice, no pressure.
